tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram 0.76.0 (Core 0.362.0): without a terminal, session start qr and setup print the login QR code as text for an agent to paste into the chat as a code block, and a renewed code is pasted again; --json adds one {"event":"qr"} stderr line per code; --qr-file is removed; login stays off MCP. store clear --left names the chats it deletes and takes --dry-run. Core 0.351.0-0.362.0 fixes chats leave/join store updates, sent-message chat, re-keyed chat privacy, hidden-chat search, schedule last.json and the first serve after an upgrade; messages forward answers with the copy in the target chat. Changed native pages: changelog, cli-contract, commands, people (snake_case sample), query-language, rankings and cli-contract (cli-core links pinned to v0.350.0), security, sessions, troubleshooting (renamed heading), usage; RU/ES updated. The troubleshooting correction that quoted --qr-file <png> is retired: the heading is gone. Roadmap unchanged: richer sending, chat notes and max parity are not shipped.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX 0.64.0-0.65.0 (Core 0.362.0): 0.64.0 briefly added --qr-file and stopped opening the QR code in a browser in a narrow terminal; 0.65.0 removes --qr-file, and without a terminal session start qr and setup print the QR code as text for an agent to paste as a code block; one code per run, about 2 minutes, rerun when it expires; the cloud password needs a terminal; login is not on MCP. store clear --left names its chats and takes --dry-run; a chat the owner returned to is no longer marked left. Changed native pages: changelog, commands, security (checks everything in the table), sessions (new Login through an agent section), and release links in bot/cli-contract/usage; EN/ES (and RU commands) updated. Roadmap unchanged: optional local copy, event actions, video notes, cloud password and native installers are not shipped.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.30.0 (Core 0.348.0): zm session start works without a terminal, printing 'Open this URL to approve Zoom login:' and the URL on stderr (kept with --quiet) and waiting for the browser callback on this computer; only the paste fallback needs a terminal; --no-input and CI still refuse; --interactive is removed. Changed native pages: changelog, commands, installation (Windows and cache folders in the uninstall list), security (any other write is refused), sessions (agent paragraph), troubleshooting; RU/ES updated. Roadmap unchanged: broader meeting preparation remains planned and is not shipped.
